records.claim: One study reported a possible increased chance of pyloric stenosis (a condition that can cause vomiting in infants) among infants whose mothers were prescribed erythromycin during delivery or within 90 days after delivery. Although some of the mothers were breastfeeding, it was not known whether they took the medication. Other studies have not found an association between erythromycin use during breastfeeding and an increased chance of pyloric stenosis in infants.
